newsitem.title: USA: Demand strong, more US corporate debt issues coming.
newsitem.headline: Demand strong, more US corporate debt issues coming.

text.p: Strong buyside demand and an improved interest rate environment should continue to spur U.S. corporations to tap the primary debt market, dealers said.

So far, Tenneco Inc sold $300 million in a two-part debt offering via Merrill Lynch & Co. The firm issued $100 million in 10-year debt to yield 71 basis points over Treasuries and another $200 million in 30-year debentures to yield 98 basis points.
"The Tenneco deal went very well," said one syndicate source. "It met good demand."
